buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses · A duly filled compliance statement as per the ATC document should be submitted with bid docum ents. · Warranty period shall be minimum 01 year from the date of receipt and acceptance of item. · For bid/GeM contract related queries write to email: pso_b@ursc.gov.in. · Submit the land border declaration as per the ATC document along with the bid with respect to O M No. F.7/10/2021-PPD(1) dated 23-02-2023 issued by Ministry of Finance, Dept. of Expenditure, P ublic Procurement Division. · Bidder should declare the exact percentage of local content, breakup of local content, details of t he location(s) at which the local value addition is made & self-declaration that the offered item me ets the local content requirement for Class-I/Class-II local supplier. · The tendered item(s) is eligible for concessional rate of SGST @ 2.5% in terms of Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dated the 17-09-2025 issued by Department of Revenue, Ministry of Fin ance, Government of India, and concessional rate of SGST @ 2.5% in terms of Notification No. 9/2 025 dated the 19-09-2025 issued by Finance Secretariat, Government of Karnataka, or as applica ble for procurement of Scientific and technical instruments, apparatus, equipment, accessories, pa rts, components, spares, tools, mock ups and modules, raw material and consumables required fo r launch vehicles and satellites and payloads. · The tendered item(s) is eligible for concessional rate of IGST @ 5% in terms of Notification No. 9/20 25-Integrated Tax (Rate) dated 17-09-2025 issued by Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India, or as applicable for procurement of Scientific and technical instruments, app aratus, equipment, accessories, parts, components, spares, tools, mock ups and modules, raw ma

terial and consumables required for launch vehicles and satellites and payloads. · U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), Bengaluru is exempted from payment of Customs Duty and Soci al Welfare Surcharge on Customs Duty for the tendered item(s) as per Notification No. 45/2025-Cu stoms dated 24-10-2025 (Sl No.340) and Notification No. 02/2026-Customs dated 01-02-2026 issu ed by the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India. However, IGST @5% shall be applicable on the import value. URSC shall issue the necessary certificate for the items covered under the said notification, provid ed the same is requested by the bidder in their offer. Accordingly, the prices shall be quoted exclu sive of Customs Duty. · The successful bidder shall submit performance security in the form of a Bank Guarantee/Account Payee Demand Draft Draft/Fixed Deposit Receipt/ Insurance Surety Bonds with a validity of 60 days beyond the Delivery period + Warranty period. . 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 5. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address ISITE Campus, U.R. Rao Satellite Centre, Outer Ring Road, Near Kartik Nagar Bus Stop, Doddanekundi Main Road, Marathahalli, Bengaluru-560037 . 6. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.
